description:
Young Mania Rating Scale (YMRS) - 11-item clinician-rated scale for assessing manic symptoms.
        
Scoring:
- Items 1,2,3,4,6,7,10,11: Each scored 0-4
- Items 5,8,9: Each scored 0-8 (even numbers only: 0,2,4,6,8)
- Total score range: 0-60
- Higher scores indicate greater severity of mania

Administration Time: 15-30 minutes
Assessment Period: Previous 48 hours
name: YMRS Standard

questions.option_1: Mildly or possibly increased on questioning
questions.option_2: Definite subjective elevation; optimistic, self-confident; cheerful; appropriate to content
questions.question: Elevated Mood

questions.option_3: Excessive energy; hyperactive at times; restless (can be calmed)
questions.option_4: Motor excitement; continuous hyperactivity (cannot be calmed)
questions.question: Increased Motor Activity-Energy

questions.option_3: Spontaneous sexual content; elaborates on sexual matters; hypersexual by self-report
questions.option_4: Overt sexual acts (toward patients, staff, or interviewer)
questions.question: Sexual Interest

questions.option_1: Sleeping less than normal amount by up to one hour
questions.option_2: Sleeping less than normal by more than one hour
questions.question: Sleep

questions.option_4: Irritable at times during interview; recent episodes of anger or annoyance on ward
questions.option_6: Frequently irritable during interview; short, curt throughout
questions.question: Irritability

questions.option_2: Increased rate or amount at times, verbose at times
questions.option_3: Push; consistently increased rate and amount; difficult to interrupt
questions.question: Speech (Rate and Amount)

questions.option_2: Distractible, loses goal of thought; changes topics frequently; racing thoughts
questions.option_3: Flight of ideas; tangentiality; difficult to follow; rhyming, echolalia
questions.question: Language-Thought Disorder

questions.option_6: Grandiose or paranoid ideas; ideas of reference
questions.question: Content

questions.option_0: Present; admits illness; agrees with need for treatment
questions.option_2: Admits behavior change, but denies illness
questions.option_3: Admits possible change in behavior, but denies illness
questions.question: Insight
